clause_ref: Information Security and Cyber Incident Management Policy
text:
Information Security and Cyber Incident Management Policy
Bharat Unity Bank Ltd.

heading_path: Information Security and Cyber Incident Management Policy
Information Security and Cyber Incident Management Policy
1. Purpose and Scope
text: 1.1 This Policy establishes the information security and cyber incident management framework of the Bank for all information assets, including those operated by service providers.

heading_path: Information Security and Cyber Incident Management Policy
Information Security and Cyber Incident Management Policy
2. Governance
text: 2.1 Board policy and CISO [ISB-C01]. The Board shall approve this Policy and the Bank shall appoint a Chief Information Security Officer reporting independently of the IT function. Control owner: Chief Information Security Officer. Frequency: Annual.

heading_path: Information Security and Cyber Incident Management Policy
Information Security and Cyber Incident Management Policy
3. Access Management
text: 3.1 Role-based access and leaver revocation [ISB-C02]. Access to information systems shall be granted on a role basis, and access of leavers shall be revoked within one working day of exit. Control owner: Head of IT Operations. Frequency: Event Driven.

heading_path: Information Security and Cyber Incident Management Policy
3. Access Management
text: 3.2 Quarterly review of internal privileged accounts [ISB-C03]. All internal privileged accounts shall be reviewed every quarter by the system owner. Control owner: System Owners. Frequency: Quarterly.

heading_path: Information Security and Cyber Incident Management Policy
3. Access Management
text: 3.3 Multi-factor authentication [ISB-C04]. Multi-factor authentication shall be enforced for all privileged and remote access. Control owner: Head of IT Operations. Frequency: Continuous.

heading_path: Information Security and Cyber Incident Management Policy
Information Security and Cyber Incident Management Policy
4. Technical Controls
text: 4.1 Vulnerability management [ISB-C05]. Vulnerability assessments shall be conducted every quarter, and critical vulnerabilities shall be remediated within 15 days of identification. Control owner: Chief Information Security Officer. Frequency: Quarterly.

heading_path: Information Security and Cyber Incident Management Policy
4. Technical Controls
text: 4.2 Log retention [ISB-C06]. Logs of all ICT systems shall be maintained securely within Indian jurisdiction for a rolling period of 180 days. Control owner: Head of IT Operations. Frequency: Continuous.

heading_path: Information Security and Cyber Incident Management Policy
4. Technical Controls
text: 4.3 Encryption standards [ISB-C07]. Data at rest shall be encrypted using AES-256 or stronger and data in transit shall be protected using TLS 1.2 or higher. Control owner: Chief Information Security Officer. Frequency: Continuous.

heading_path: Information Security and Cyber Incident Management Policy
Information Security and Cyber Incident Management Policy
5. Incident Management
text: 5.1 Cyber incident reporting [ISB-C08]. Cyber security incidents shall be reported to CERT-In within six hours of being noticed and to the Reserve Bank of India within the timelines prescribed by it. Control owner: Chief Information Security Officer. Frequency: Event Driven.

heading_path: Information Security and Cyber Incident Management Policy
Information Security and Cyber Incident Management Policy
6. Awareness
text: 6.1 Security awareness training [ISB-C09]. All employees shall complete information security awareness training annually. Control owner: Head of HR. Frequency: Annual.
